svg.title: AREA 29
svg.desc: Use only front-left from the entrance, upper-right red here; avoid the other three pads. The Garanz runner scouts first and signals the party after handling it; the large room also has traps omitted by the red-route map. Use the lower route after the large room and clear the short hallway’s traps before the dark room. The light unlocks only after enemies are cleared. Use the minimap first; the Force then lights the room and takes boxes. After clearing the pre-boss room, one returns to the timer. Others wait by the room’s door to help, not at the far fence. The timer raises a turret by the door. Waiting players destroy it immediately so the runner can pass before time expires; share supplies afterward.
